localBusinessContext.title: Sthaniy & Mausami Karobar Sandarbh
localBusinessContext.subtitleContext: {{location}} vich {{business}} layi operational ate jalvayu vichar
localBusinessContext.disclaimerTitle: AI-Estimated Samanya Salah — Satyapit Sthaniy Data Nahi
localBusinessContext.disclaimerDesc: Eh operational insights ate mausami patterns AI general knowledge da upyog karke anumanit kitte gaye han. Apne sabse nede Mandi, Zila Udyog Kendra (DIC), ya Krishi Vigyan Kendra (KVK) de naal hamesha current mool, bajar mang, ate sthaniy niyaman di pushti karo.
localBusinessContext.demandFestiveDesc: {{location}} vich {{business}} di mang byah ate tyohar cycle (Diwali, Chhath, Bihu, Pongal, Eid) de dauran aamtor te 25–40% wadh jandi hai. 30 din pehla extra working capital plan karo.
localBusinessContext.demandMonsoonDesc: Monsoon mahine aamtor te asthai sadak transit deri ate sthaniy haftavari haat mandayi lende han. 15 din da kaccha maal inventory buffer rakho.
localBusinessContext.demandSummerDesc: Garmi de lean mahine kam mang wale haftayian nu bharn layi akramak sthaniy sambandh prabandhan ate cash flow budgeting di mang karde han.
localBusinessContext.inputSourcingDesc: 15–20% gross margin advantage surakshit karan layi retail intermediaries di bjay thok zila distributors ya farmer-producer cooperatives (FPOs) ton sidha kaccha maal lao.
localBusinessContext.powerPrecautionsDesc: Grind bijli de utchav-chadhav machine downtime ya pashudhan mrityu da karan ban sakde han. Apne CapEx proposal vich solar rooftop subsidies (PM Surya Ghar) ya diesel backup generator nu shamil karo.
localBusinessContext.shgLinkagesDesc: Bari sthaniy sansthangat order ate sarkari tender preference prapt karan layi sthaniy Self-Help Groups (SHGs), Gram Panchayats, ya Zila MSME facilitation cells de naal saajhedari karo.
